2609.08550.title: CreaMem: A Scene-Aware Memory Architecture for Personalized Agents
2609.08550.paper_summary: Long-term memory is a core capability for personalized LLM agents. To support it, existing memory systems organize information using various criteria such as topic segments or summary hierarchies. However, we identify two major limitations in these designs. First, they lack scene awareness: memories from unrelated life scenes share the same retrieval space, which inflates the search space and introduces cross-scene interference. Second, they encode each memory from a single perspective, making it difficult to retrieve complementary views of the same event. In this paper, we propose the CreaMem architecture, which enables scene-aware memory organization by partitioning memory into several Life Scene Memories to reduce cross-scene interference at retrieval. To go beyond the single perspective and achieve cross-memory synergy, entries are dual-coded from both episodic and trait-based perspectives within each memory. We further devise a permemory balanced sampling strategy at retrieval time. Extensive experiments on two long-term memory benchmarks show that CreaMem improves QA accuracy across all evaluation metrics, with particularly large gains on multi-hop reasoning performance, validating scene-aware partitioning and cross-memory synergy. To enhance reproducibility, we release our code in a public GitHub repository.
2609.08550.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶是個性化 LLM 代理的核心能力。為了支持這一點，現有的記憶系統使用各種標準來組織信息，例如主題段落或摘要層級。然後，我們識別出這些設計的兩個主要限制。首先，它們缺乏場景意識：來自不相關生活場景的記憶共享相同的檢索空間，這擴大了搜索空間並引入了跨場景干擾。其次，它們從單一視角編碼每個記憶，使得檢索同一事件的互補視角變得困難。在本文中，我們提出了 CreaMem 架構，通過將記憶劃分為幾個生活場景記憶來實現場景意識的記憶組織，以減少檢索時的跨場景干擾。為了超越單一視角並實現跨記憶的協同，條目在每個記憶中從情節和特徵兩個視角進行雙重編碼。我們進一步設計了一種在檢索時的平衡取樣策略。在兩個長期記憶基準上的廣泛實驗表明，CreaMem 在所有評估指標上提高了 QA 準確性，特別是在多跳推理性能上獲得了顯著增益，驗證了場景意識的劃分和跨記憶的協同。為了增強可重複性，我們在公共 GitHub 存儲庫中發布了我們的代碼。
